# MU — Catalysts

## TL;DR

**AMD earnings May 5 AMC is the live binary gate for MU.** AMD's HBM/AI demand commentary is a direct read-through for Micron within the swing window. Post-AMD, watch for MU pullback to $502-520 (the actionable entry zone per swing_trend_momentum and macro_context). Next scheduled Micron binary is Q3 FY26 earnings ~June 24, 2026 (consensus EPS $18.97; guide was $33.5B revenue at ~81% GM). Most sell-side PTs are now below spot $576 — upgrade cycle largely priced. [source: web_research/MU.json, signals_combined.json swing_head_trader MU, run 20260504_212836]

## Upcoming events

- **AMD Q1 2026 earnings — May 5, 2026 AMC (TOMORROW):** Direct HBM demand binary. AMD's guidance on AI data center spending immediately reprices MU. Negative commentary → MU gap down 5-10% risk. Positive → validates bull thesis, potentially lifts MU but may not provide the pullback needed for entry. [source: signals_combined.json swing_macro_context MU, run 20260504_212836]
- **Q3 FY26 earnings — ~June 24, 2026** (one source cites July 1). Consensus EPS $18.97. Prior guide: $33.5B ± $0.75B revenue, ~81% non-GAAP gross margin. [source: web_research/MU.json earnings_info, run 20260504_212836]
- **JEDEC industry presentations — May 12 and May 13, 2026:** Micron presenting on mobile/edge computing (May 12) and server/cloud AI memory (May 13) — signals deep engagement with next-gen AI memory standards; could surface positive HBM4 news. [source: web_research/MU.json ticker_news, run 20260504_212836]
- **Samsung HBM4 NVIDIA qualification:** Active risk event. Samsung expects HBM3E qualification to push share above 30%; all three suppliers competing for NVIDIA HBM4 16-Hi contracts for Q4 2026. If Samsung qualifies, Micron's ASPs and share face compression. [source: web_research/MU.json competitor_activity, run 20260504_212836]
- **SK Hynix $12.85B new packaging facility:** Announced April 22, 2026 — extending the HBM market leader's manufacturing advantage. [source: web_research/MU.json competitor_activity, run 20260504_212836]

## Recent news synthesis (last 14 days)

- **2026-05-04 — MU +4.06% open, DA Davidson $1,000 PT initiation:** DA Davidson initiated Buy at $1,000 (highest on Wall Street). MU +96% YTD. [source: web_research/MU.json ticker_news]
- **2026-04-28 — TD Cowen PT raised to $660:** Maintained Buy, raised from $550. UBS reiterated Buy, raised PT to $535. [source: web_research/MU.json analyst_consensus]
- **2026-04-02 — Erste Group downgraded to Hold:** Cited stretched valuation. Seeking Alpha issued two Sell articles. [source: web_research/MU.json ticker_news]
- **Q2 FY26 print (Mar 2026):** Revenue $23.86B (+196% YoY, +75% QoQ), GAAP EPS $12.07 / non-GAAP $12.20. Cloud Memory $7.7B, Core Data Center $5.7B. Q3 FY26 guide: $33.5B at ~81% non-GAAP GM. [source: web_research/MU.json earnings_info]

## Insider activity

No Form 4 data available in this run. Prior bootstrap noted no recent open-market purchases; refreshing next run. [source: signals_combined.json swing_catalyst_news MU, run 20260504_212836]

## Analyst consensus

Rating: **Strong Buy** (~31 analysts). Consensus EPS PT aggregators: avg range $482–$551 (median ~$525). At $576 spot, most published PTs are now below spot — only DA Davidson ($1,000) and TD Cowen ($660) offer upside from current price. Additional coverage: UBS Buy $535, JPMorgan $550, Morgan Stanley $450, Bank of America $300. Outlier bear targets $150–$250 reflect cyclical peak concerns. The upgrade cycle that drove the rally from ~$488 to $576 may be largely priced. [source: web_research/MU.json analyst_consensus, run 20260504_212836]

## Lessons

2026-04-30 | NVDA | EMA pullback Fib dip-buy | -$63.20 (corrected from -$264.65) | Stop triggered at $205.30 (hourly Fib 61.8%); swing_trend_momentum and swing_breakout were bullish on AI capex thesis, but price breached the stop zone intraday amid stretched macro (RSI 81–87) with no bullish confirmation candle before exit. **Note:** trade was originally sized 67 shares ($14,020) due to a phantom $100K budget bug (fixed commit b2b472d).
